summary: Iteration 1 full-stack testing of YourFleetAI v2. Backend: 21/21 pytest passed including AI (Claude Sonnet 4.6 monthly summary, Gemini 3 Flash quick alert), auth, dashboard, trucks/trips/fuel/invoices CRUD, GST intra+interstate computation, receivables aging, accounting P&L, multi-tenant isolation, public LR tracking, team invite. Frontend: 14/14 Playwright flows passed including landing page, public shipment tracking by LR, demo login, dashboard stats+P&L chart+compliance list, all 15 sidebar nav items, dark/light theme toggle, Trucks add/search/delete, AI Insights (profitability leaderboard + Gemini answer), Accounting, Invoices create with GST + aging tiles, Trips LR-numbered rows, Signup creates isolated tenant (0/0 trucks) proving multi-tenancy, Logout. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: contract_investment is added to the expense sub-breakdown but is NOT included in expense.total sum (line 460-463). Either include it in total or move it out of expense — currently inconsistent.
Uses db.trucks.find_one without company scoping — a truck belonging to another tenant could theoretically be returned if trip.truck_id matched (very low risk since trip is company-scoped).

trips_this_month uses .replace(day=1).date().isoformat() but start_date is stored as isoformat string; comparison with $gte works only if dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD (which they are). OK today but fragile if seconds/tz added.

ui_bugs.issue: Recharts ResponsiveContainer prints console warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' on first render (harmless but noisy)
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — a11y warning from Radix

design_issues.screen: Landing hero, Trips table, Dashboard tiles
issues: Overall dark theme is polished; contrast is good. Orange primary on dark background is readable. No visible design defects.

action_items: (minor) Include contract_investment in accounting expense.total or move it to a separate section — currently listed but excluded from sum.
(minor) Fix Radix Dialog a11y warning by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby in CrudTable.jsx and Invoices.jsx dialogs.
(nit) Optionally scope /api/trips/{id}/lr truck lookup by company_id.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 720 lines — should be split into routers/ (auth.py, dashboard.py, trips.py, invoices.py, ai.py) for maintainability once it grows further.
make_crud generic list endpoint's `q` search filters client-side after fetching 500 docs — fine for MVP, but should push to Mongo query for scale.
accounting_month called directly from ai_monthly_summary passing raw `u` dict — works but tightly couples endpoints. Consider extracting to a service function.
InvoiceItem validation is loose: no server-side check that item.amount == quantity*rate; only client computes it.
Trip lr_number generation uses count+1 which can create duplicates under high concurrency. Should use an atomic counter or Mongo findAndModify.
Fuel anomaly `prior` lookup uses sort by 'date' string — works if dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD but will misorder if formats differ.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup auto-seeds Demo Transport Co. with 3 trucks, 2 drivers, 1 customer, 3 trips (LR-2026-00001..3), 3 fuel entries, 1 maintenance, 3 FASTag, 4 compliance docs (incl. expired), 1 invoice. Tests created and cleaned up TEST_* records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: First iteration is clean and green end-to-end. If main agent adds new modules, extend backend_test.py with corresponding TestClass. UI CrudTable is reused across 11 modules; testing Trucks CRUD is representative. AI endpoints do real network calls (Claude ~15s, Gemini ~3s) — allow generous timeouts. Public tracking works without auth. Multi-tenancy verified via signup+cross-account read.
